author: Sevoo
body:
I've decided to make a list of all the problems, because it's getting unbearable, and instead of bashing on the mods I've decided to help them by making a list. What this does is make the staff aware of the problems, and they should fix it ASAP. Any problems that you have encountered are going to be listed here. This is not to hate on the staff, it is simply a list. If this is something that you feel should be locked, tell me, and I'll archive it :) And you guys have to give me the problems xD

Without further ado, here is the list:

-Block lag.
-Biased knockback.
-Nexus & CTH Fasthit.
-Name tag glitch.
-Killing someone and dying afterwards because of his hit being late
In "The walls" Before the match starts and you walk into limes quadrin and you are in limes team you will spawn where ever you are in the quadrin. Again, This only works if you are in the exact quadrin your team would normally spawn in.
-When in the game menu (game booklet), clicking on a server and ending up on a different one because of the servers constantly changing lots.

Ill keep this as updated as I can, just don't freak out when I don't, I have school and its hard sometimes xP
